content: बर्बरः .²1 One not an Aryan, a barbarian, low fellow; तैस्ते यवनकाम्बोजा बर्बराश्चाकुलीकृताः <ls>Rām. 1. 54. 23</ls>. .²2 A fool, block-head; शृणु रे बर्बर <ls>H. 2</ls>. .²3 An elephant in the fourth year; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 5</ls>. .{@-रा@} A kind of fly. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Vermilion. .²2 Gum-myrrh. .²3 yellow sandal-wood.
